title: [NatWest demo] SPA network connection changed
description: Detects browser-side network transitions emitted by the SPA's network audit beacon (frontend/src/rum.ts -> /api/network/event -> nwpay_audit). Fires one ITSI notable per session-effective_type pair when the browser flips from one connectivity class to a worse one (e.g. wifi -> 3g, 4g -> 2g) within a 5-minute window. Pairs with the Splunk Observability detector '[NatWest demo] Madrid p95 latency' so Episode Review correlates 'the customer's network just got slower' with 'their payments p95 just spiked'. Bridges a signal that otherwise lives only in Splunk Observability Cloud (RUM `network.context` spans) into Splunk Enterprise so ITSI on-call can see it without context-switching. The dedupe key (cohort_key) collapses repeated firings on the same session+from->to pair inside the same Episode so the on-call sees one ticket per cohort, not five.
search: index=nwpay_audit event_type=network source="change" previous_effective_type=* effective_type=* | where previous_effective_type!=effective_type AND previous_effective_type!="unknown" AND effective_type!="unknown" | eval rank_4g=4, rank_wifi=4, rank_ethernet=5, rank_3g=3, rank_2g=2, rank_slow_2g=1, rank_unknown=0 | eval prev_rank=case(previous_effective_type="ethernet",5, previous_effective_type="wifi",4, previous_effective_type="4g",4, previous_effective_type="3g",3, previous_effective_type="2g",2, previous_effective_type="slow-2g",1, true(),0) | eval new_rank=case(effective_type="ethernet",5, effective_type="wifi",4, effective_type="4g",4, effective_type="3g",3, effective_type="2g",2, effective_type="slow-2g",1, true(),0) | eval delta=new_rank-prev_rank | bin _time span=5m | stats count as flips, values(customer_tier) as tiers, min(delta) as worst_delta, latest(effective_type) as latest_type, latest(previous_effective_type) as previous_type by _time, session_id | where flips>=1 AND worst_delta<=-1 | eval severity=case(worst_delta<=-3, "6", worst_delta<=-2, "5", true(), "4") | eval service=if(mvcount(tiers)>0, "Customer Tier Experience", "Digital Customer Experience") | eval title="SPA network degradation: " . previous_type . " -> " . latest_type . " (" . flips . " flips, session " . substr(session_id, 1, 8) . ")" | eval cohort_key="network_change:" . session_id . ":" . previous_type . ":" . latest_type . ":" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M") | eval source="Splunk ES - SPA network audit" | eval description=title . " - tiers seen on this session: " . mvjoin(tiers, ", ") . ". Cross-check the Madrid p95 detector and SPA p95 by network type chart in the Payments Operations dashboard before assuming a backend regression." | eval service_ids = if(service="Customer Tier Experience", "nwpay_l2_customer_tier_experience,nwpay_l2_dce", "nwpay_l2_dce") | table _time, severity, service, service_ids, title, source, session_id, previous_type, latest_type, flips, worst_delta, tiers, cohort_key, description
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
